text:
alex: Heads-up — my docs PR (redwood-inference/docs#4821) failed the docs-preview after the Vale rules change. Short log excerpt below.

docs-bot: CI preview for PR #4821 — status: failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/preview/4821

alex: Vale errors:
```text
ERROR: docs/advanced/serving.md:37: Passive voice: "Models are served by the runtime..." (vale: PassiveVoice rule)
ERROR: docs/getting-started/quickstart.md:12: Smart quote detected: ’ (spell:smart-quotes)
```

priya: ugh, the PassiveVoice rule landed in .vale yesterday. can we relax it for these legacy pages? :thinking:

sam: is linkcheck failing too, or just vale/spell?

alex: linkcheck shows a broken anchor on the deployment page: the anchor we linked to is `#private-deployments` but the heading slug is `deployment-private`. so linkcheck error + vale + smart quotes.

maria: I can do a tiny patch: 1) reword the passive sentence to active voice, 2) fix the anchor to the canonical slug, 3) replace the smart quote in quickstart. want me to push?

priya: yes please — and run locally so we don't do multiple CI runs. `vale --config .vale.ini --minAlertLevel error docs/` should reproduce the failing rules. also `python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt` if you need the spellchecker.

maria: running now. if green I'll push branch `docs/pr-4821-quickfix` and request review from @priya.

docs-bot: build queued by maria — preview URL: https://preview.redwood.example/pr-4821-quickfix

alex: if we need unblock fast, fallback is to add a file-level exception: `# vale: disable PassiveVoice` at top of the file. but prefer wording changes first.

sam: agree — avoid disabling rules unless absolutely necessary. small wording edits are better for long-term docs quality.

maria: pushed the fix. preview: https://preview.redwood.example/pr-4821-quickfix-2

priya: reviewing now :eyes:

priya: LGTM for the serving and anchor fix. CI still flags quickstart line 12 — looks like a curly quote slipped in from a copy-paste example: `It’s` vs `It's`.

alex: I can patch that ASAP. will replace smart quotes with ASCII.

maria: after alex patches, can we schedule merge for 16:00 PT during docs merge window? avoids mid-day churn.

sam: 16:00 PT works for me. I'll monitor the preview and merge if green. :+1:

priya: also let's add a short note to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md about the new Vale rule and a quick command to run local linting. saves folks time.

alex: done — I added `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` TODO and a sample `vale --config .vale.ini docs/` command. will open a follow-up PR for docs contributor notes.

maria: preview is green now, all checks passed. :tada:

docs-bot: PR #4821 preview succeeded — ready for merge.

sam: merging at 16:00 PT.

alex: thanks all! :shipit:
